prompt: Review an oRPC router (User resource with numeric id, embedded workspace, /get-user paths, POST for list, PUT for create/update, lowercase enum, offset/limit pagination) and identify what's wrong with it.

assertions.text: Identifies that `id: number` + `workspaceId` tuple should be a single hierarchical `name` string
Identifies that embedded `workspace: { id, name }` should be a reference by name string
Identifies that verb-in-path (/get-user, /list-users, /user/new) should be resource-oriented paths
Identifies that POST /list-users should be GET on a resource path
Identifies that PUT for create should be POST
Identifies that PUT-full-replace for update should be PATCH-partial + updateMask
Identifies that enum members should be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE with _UNSPECIFIED zero value
Identifies that offset/limit pagination should be pageSize/pageToken
Cites at least two specific AIPs (e.g. AIP-121, AIP-122, AIP-126, AIP-130)
Provides a corrected version of the router (not just prose)
